rationale: C04 is the concrete directive that the child expressly supplements and modifies. The child repeats C04's statutory basis, identifies it by its June 8, 1953 date, preserves its lists and operative import-control framework, then creates a narrow exemption from its restrictions and adds a clarifying footnote to List I. C12 and C17 are weaker precedents for the same section 22 finding-and-modification machinery, but neither supplied the specific provisions being amended.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I issued a proclamation on June 8, 1953, providing that...the products specified in Lists I, II, and III...shall...be subject to the quantitative limitations and fees set forth in such lists
shared_material.parent_excerpt: on and after July 1, 1953, articles included in the lists appended to and hereby made a part of this proclamation shall be subject to quantitative limitations and fees
shared_material.explanation: The child expressly identifies and summarizes C04's central operative scheme.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the release...of those products specified in Lists I and II...will not render, or tend to render, ineffective or materially interfere with any program or operation of the Department of Agriculture...nor reduce substantially the amount of products processed in the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the entry...of such articles will not render or tend to render ineffective, or materially interfere with, the said programs or operations, or reduce substantially the amount of products processed in the United States
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C04's distinctive statutory findings to justify an exemption from the restrictions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the provisions of the said proclamation of June 8, 1953, shall not apply with respect to articles specified in Lists I and II which may be imported as samples...or for the personal use of the importer
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The provisions of this proclamation shall not apply to articles imported by or for the account of any department or agency of the Government of the United States.
shared_material.explanation: The child uses C04's exemption mechanism and parallel 'shall not apply' formulation for additional classes of imports.

shared_material.child_excerpt: there shall be added as a footnote to List I this statement
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Articles included in Lists I and II... [and] Articles included in List III
shared_material.explanation: The child directly amends one of C04's incorporated lists, demonstrating continuation of the same administrative instrument rather than merely a shared subject.
